en.headline: Suzhou Dongshan seeks up to US$1.36 billion in Hong Kong IPO
en.dek: The circuit board maker’s offering trails earlier expectations amid concerns over potential US trade restrictions on its optical modules business.
body: Suzhou Dongshan Precision Manufacturing is seeking to raise up to HK$10.67 billion, or about US$1.36 billion, in its Hong Kong initial public offering, according to a regulatory filing on Tuesday.

The Shenzhen-listed company is offering 113.8 million H shares at up to HK$93.80 each. Cornerstone investors including Alibaba and JPMorgan’s asset management arm have committed to about US$680 million. Final pricing is expected on 26 October, with trading scheduled to begin on 28 October.

Analysts said the size is below earlier hopes of up to US$3 billion, as investors weighed risks of US trade restrictions on the firm’s optical modules alongside a more cautious market for large listings. Proceeds will fund expansion of production facilities for high-speed chips and optical modules in mainland China.

zh.headline: 東山精密計劃在港招股集資最多13.6億美元
zh.dek: 印刷電路板製造商發售規模低於早前預期，市場憂慮其光模塊業務或受美國貿易限制影響。
body: 深圳上市的東山精密製造周二提交監管文件，計劃在香港首次公開招股，最多集資106.7億港元，約13.6億美元。
公司擬發行1.138億股H股，最高發售價每股93.80港元。包括阿里巴巴及摩根資產管理在內的基石投資者已承諾認購約6.8億美元。最終定價預計10月26日，股份擬於10月28日掛牌。
分析指集資規模低於早前最高30億美元的預期，投資者權衡美國可能對其光模塊業務實施貿易限制，以及市場對大型招股較為審慎。所得款項將用於擴建內地高速芯片及光模塊產能。
